txt: As your bellow echoes through the street, the boys quiver ever so slightly and gaze down at their shoes, pretending to be deaf.
No reply. The blond rebel scratches his chin, deliberately not focusing his gaze on anything. He looks very uncomfortable.
"A snazzy shit-ripped SKULL-mobile like this would make a fine trophy. We could, like, hang fucking shrunken heads from the side mirrors! Cops' heads... Scary tribal shit."
"Also, he was hanged."

"Also, you've got to admit, it catches the eye. And since the grand piper is slowly but steadily moving towards basing the economy on it -- attention -- it is imperative that the medium itself convey the message."
"And what kind of business is that exactly?"
"Be wary of the abyss," his blond friend adds ominously and points to his temple.
"Because we can be just as psycho and vicious. You'll see."
"By the way, if you see Cindy, give her our regards," he adds, returning from whatever void he was just visiting.
"Cold-hearted cop..."
"Fine, fuck it." The young man takes his jacket off. "Here, take it then. I can't handle this sad shit."
"Fuck, I'm sorry, man." He hangs his head in shame. "I just... don't like confrontations that's all."
"Fuck," the other one sighs deeply.
"Fucking *philosophy*, man. You can do aggressive shit with philosophy. Justify shit."
"He was hanged from a tree."
"Hey, we can be just as hard! Like pavement on top of pavement, or a brick on top of another brick."
"I'm not. I don't have a jacket anymore..."
"I, uhm, it's just theoretical work, copper. No basis in reality." He turns to his companion: "Man, if we were certified SKULLS right now..."
"If you don't *have* to answer, then we don't *have* to give you our jackets." The young man shakes his head. "Doesn't sound like you have a reason."
"It seems that we can only think but never *know*."
"Let's just go, Fuck!" The blondie -- although visibly relieved -- is nervously glancing at the traffic jam. "This scene is dead anyway."
"Mhm." He throws a longing glance at the Kineema.
"No," the young man replies quickly, shaking his head. "A different Cindy. From out of town. She doesn't know shit about armoured gloves, that's for sure."
"Nope," his mouth makes a popping sound. "But Cindy does."
"Oh yeah, Cindy's a right proper SKULL..." The young man's eyes glaze over, his voice filled with longing.
"Old man, it doesn't matter. You'll be long gone before his greatness is recognized."
"Please be quiet!" Not much is left of the nihilistic rebel at this point. The young man before you is scared out of his mind. "What... WHAT do you want?!! T-t-the jackets?"
"Possessing an infinite amount of fuck-all swagger, infamous for their non-verbal *modus operandi*."
"Pssshhew." The young man raises two fingers to his temple and an imaginary hammer hits the cartridge.
"Right on, Fuck," the blond agrees and provocatively spits on the pavement. "So what's happening now?"
"SKULLS don't talk to pigs. Or each other. They just fuck and fight."
"So are we done here or...?" one of the jacket owners asks impatiently. "You don't need us around for your secret whisper party, do you?"
"So what do you think we know?"
"Sure, sure," the blond man says, quickly nodding. "Understandable. Fuck and I appreciate your effort though."
"That ride is fucking lightning!" the young man exclaims.
"That's one brutal motor carriage," says the young man with 'PISSF****T' written on his back.
"The SKULLS are the most vicious gang of the Besmertnyé." His voice rings with excitement.
"The palm tree livery should be, like, pastel green. Fucking tropic shit..." He gazes dreamily at Lieutenant Kitsuragi's motor carriage.
"The question was rhetorical," he replies, raising his open hand. "The SKULLS are *the* most vicious gang of the Besmertnyé."

"The word PISSF****T epitomizes the struggle taking place in the world, things being defined as they seem, not as they are. And -- I guess -- it's also about communal spirit, the future, and *truly* appreciating our differences."
"Ugh..." A sudden flash of panic flies across his face. "I... I didn't mean anything by that. Just playing with words here, that's all."
"Uh... that's right," the young man says, looking unsure of himself. "You... you should back off and let silence rule supreme."
"Uh..." He looks confused. "Well... yeah I mean, we're only saying *practice* things for now, so... We don't mean no harm to the SKULLS brand. Or to you."
"We're not *franchised* SKULLS -- well, not yet. Once we get our name out there, we'll have a chance to join them."
"Well, first off, it's a statement and not *necessarily* something that characterizes me as a person, even though the statement has character. And I *do* like piss..."
"Well," the young man remarks in a voice filled with longing, eyes glazed over, "there's Cindy..."
"What I mean by this is -- we are *all* Pissf****ts. And that the world is inherently meaningless."
"What about them?"
"What if it's art... or just a mere spectre?"
"Whatever, man. Work is for pussies." The young man frowns, aggrieved. "You wouldn't get it anyway."
"Which is not to say that the SKULLS are bitches and f****ts. On the contrary..."
"Yeah -- the skull symbolizes the embrace of death and nothingness, present in all of us, the vehicle of our future operations. Death and nothingness."
"Yeah we are!" The young men exchange approving nods.
"Yeah, didn't you cops, like, have some questions about SKULLs or some shit?"
"Yeah, man, keep your voice down. SKULLS don't take it lightly, when folks pretend to be them. We're not even *prospects* yet."
"Yeah, no need to throw your authority in our faces."
"Yeah, we're not fucking kids!" He glances at your partner and quickly adds: "And we're also not fucking confrontational. The mood is chill here."
"Yeah," the blond man replies with a nod. "That's what I mean. You're young as fuck, don't worry."
"Yeah," the blond man replies. "Let's get out of here. The cops fucked us."
"Yep." He nods enthusiastically. "Old as fuck."
"You already said she's a SKULL..." he mumbles apologetically. "The last I saw her, she was hanging around the old apartment building near the pier."
"You're fucking ancient, man."
